notice.subject: Correction needed: ClearPath Cash Back Visa post (CP-2026-0131-v1)
notice.body:
Hi Tara,

Our monitoring checked your post "Best cash back cards of 2026" on Nov 2 and found that it no longer shows the required rewards terms disclosure.

What to fix:
- Add this text directly below the 2% cash back amount: "Cash back is paid as a statement credit each quarter; some purchases do not earn rewards, see the rewards terms."

Please make the change by Nov 3. The approved version is CP-2026-0131-v1. Reply to this email when it is done, and we will check the page again.

Thank you,
Jordan Kim
Compliance, ClearPath Credit Union
